<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex014022026-09-2901-28-41" status="unreviewed"><lb n="131a4"/> de gnyis kyi khyad par ni 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db3839">rtsang</rs></note> rnam 'jog chos gzhan nges pa la mi ltos 
pa dang ltos pa'o zer ba ni mi 'thad de |
nog lkog shal la sogs 'dus pa la mtshon bya'i 
don ldog gzhi la grub kyis mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad mtshon pa'i tshe mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi 
la grub ste btags yod du 'gyur te ba lang gi tha snyad kyi rnam 'jog chos gzhan nog lkog 

shal nges pa la ltos pa'i phyir ro || 
des na rang gi rnam 'jog gi rgyu nges pa la ma ltos pa 
dang ltos nas rtogs par bya ba yin no || </seg></TEI>
